extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A synthetic texture dataset spanning 246,285 images across 56 texture classes, generated using text-to-image models to support a broad range of texture-based tasks.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak and Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was generated in three steps: creating texture-specific prompts, using these prompts as inputs to Stable Diffusion models to generate images, and refining the output through frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The source data consists of descriptive text prompts created by combining artistically-informed descriptors across various texture classes.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Supporting a broad range of texture-based tasks, including measuring texture bias by uncovering associations between learned textures and objects in object classification models.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The generated images undergo a three-stage refinement/filtering process to ensure quality and alignment. This includes frequency filtering to remove object-like images, patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images, and CLIP score filtering. Additionally, any images flagged by the Stable Diffusion NSFW filter are excluded.

name.evidence: ...we create the Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD), a new texture dataset spanning 246,285 images across 56 texture classes.

description.evidence: Here, we translate descriptive prompts into visually representative texture images by adapting traditional text-to-image pipelines with texture-specific considerations. These adaptations allow us to create the Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD), a dataset of 246,285 texture images across 56 texture classes.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: This process consists of three filtering steps, each targeting different aspects of image quality: (1) frequency filtering to remove object-like images, (2) patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images, and (3) CLIP score filtering to ensure alignment with the prompts.
